classification: All frozen final_test rows; selected model and the two frozen baselines only; no fitting, replacement, selection, recalibration or sensitivity search
offline_execution: Batch feature/probability computation followed by the production TriageService/core/repository with a precomputed-score adapter; explicitly not cold per-request latency or timeout validation
runtime_sample_selection: First 64 final-test case IDs in SHA256(seed + case_id) order; selected before predictions; no warmups, retries or replacement of failures
runtime_execution: Separate SQLite database; actual production subprocess with default 5-second worker budget; sequential requests timed externally through commit; report parity with offline decisions
fault_population: Synthetic automated fixtures reported separately from held-out classification and observed runtime failures
latency: p50/p95/max over all 64 attempts including failed requests; local sequential sample, not production SLA, throughput, UI rendering or human confirmation time
acceptance: Use data/evaluation-protocol.json final_test criteria unchanged; report workload and anomaly counts without new quality targets
exposure: Exclusive local attempt record; completed commands reuse the result without prediction. Interrupted/exposed or changed-input attempts cannot be silently rerun as a clean test. No final-test text or examples in UI/public reports.
